follow-up time: From 11 to 13(+6) weeks gestation to 32-34 weeks gestation and before delivery
exposure: combinations of mean arterial pressure (MAP) and uterine artery doppler (UAD)
serum-free β HCG, pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A, and placental growth factor (PlGF)
finding: A combination of mean arterial pressure, uterine artery doppler, serum-free β HCG, pregnancy-associated plasma protein-A, and placental growth factor was the best screening test for predicting the overall chance of development of gestational hypertension.
